sources.title: litert-community/d1-Omni-2B-LiteRT · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: d1-Omni-2B for LiteRT This repository is a conversion of LiquidAI/d1-Omni-2B to LiteRT, made with litert-torch 0.10.0 for the CompiledModel API of ai-edge-litert 2.3.0: on an Apple M4 Max with Metal at float32 precision, one question about a 10-second audio clip takes a median 89.0 ms, and one question about the source model card's support ticket 40.9 ms (2026-11-02).
